source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 844 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 844 was established by Ordinance No. 28118, passed by the Dallas City Council on February 9, 2011. (Ord. 28118)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 844 is established on property bounded by Seaford Drive, Maddox Avenue, Coston Drive, and Condon Drive. The size of PD 844 is approximately 26.99 acres. (Ord. Nos. 28118; 31098)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 28118)

sections.title: Exhibits
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.104. EXHIBITS.

The following exhibits are incorporated into this article:

(1) Exhibit 844A: Tract 1 development plan.

(2) Exhibit 844B: Tract 2 development/landscape plan. (Ord. Nos. 28118; 31098)

SEC. 51P-844.104.1. TRACTS.

The district is divided into two tracts, Tract 1 and Tract 2. (Ord. 31098)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Tract 1. For a private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district, development and use of the Property must comply with the Tract 1 development plan (Exhibit 844A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the Tract 1 development plan, the text of this article controls.

(b) Tract 2. For a private recreation, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district, development and use of the Property must comply with the Tract 2 development/landscape plan (Exhibit 844B). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the Tract 2 development/landscape plan, the text of this article controls.

(c) All other permitted uses. For all other permitted uses, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, conceptual plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply. (Ord. Nos. 28118; 31098)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.106. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

(a) Except as provided in this section, the only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the R-7.5(A) Single Family District is subject to DIR in this district; etc.

(b) The following additional main use is permitted by right:

-- Private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district. (Ord. 28118)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.107. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 28118)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.108. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot, and space regulations for the R-7.5(A) Single Family District apply.

(b) Required yards.

(1) Tract 1. For a private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district, the minimum setback is five feet on Seaford Drive and 20 feet on Maddox Avenue, Coston Drive, and Alto Garden Drive.

(2) Tract 2. For a private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district, the minimum setback is 20 feet on Alto Garden Avenue and Dell Garden Avenue. A five-foot setback is required for side and rear yards.

(c) Floor area.

(1) Tract 1. For a private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district, maximum floor area is 15,000 square feet excluding seating area.

(2) Tract 2. For a private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district, maximum floor area is 16,175 square feet excluding seating area.

(d) Height.

(1) In general. Except as provided in this subsection, if any portion of a structure is over 26 feet in height, that portion may not be located above a residential proximity slope. Exception: Structures listed in Section 51A-4.408(a)(2) may project through the slope to a height not to exceed the maximum structure height, or 12 feet above the slope, whichever is less.

(2) Private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district. No maximum structure height.

(3) Tract 2. The standards for residential proximity slope do not apply to the following poles as shown on the Tract 2 development/landscape plan:

(A) the light poles,

(B) the support poles for the protective screens, and

(C) the fair/foul ball line poles for the baseball and softball fields.

(e) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage for nonresidential structures is 30 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(f) Lot size. For a private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district, no minimum lot size. (Ord. Nos. 28118; 31098)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.109. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A- 4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) For a private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district:

(1) Tract 1. A minimum of 520 spaces are required.

(2) Tract 2. A minimum of 220 spaces are required.

(3) Loading and screening. Parking lot and loading screening is not required.

(4) Parking in required yards. Parking is permitted in the required yards. (Ord. Nos. 28118; 30198)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.110. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 28118)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.111. LANDSCAPING.

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Tract 1. For a private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district, no landscaping is required.

(c) Tract 2. For a private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district, landscaping must comply with the Tract 2 development/landscape plan.

(d) Maintenance. Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. Nos. 28118; 31098)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.112. SIGNS.

(a) Except as provided in this section, signs must comply with the provisions for non- business zoning districts in Article VII.

(b) For a private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district, minimum setback for detached signs is 15 feet. (Ord. 28118)

SEC. 51P-844.112.1. AMPLIFIED SOUND SPEAKERS.

In Tract 2, amplified sound speakers for the athletic fields may only be used during games from 8:00 a.m. to 10:00 p.m and practice games from 8:00 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. and must be directed toward the seating areas in each field and away from any residential use. (Ord. 31098)

sections.title: Fencing
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.113. FENCING.

For a private recreation center, club, or area limited to an athletic facility for a public school district:

(1) Fencing must be provided as shown on the Tract 1 development plan and the Tract 2 development/landscape plan.

(2) Fencing may be provided in the required yards. In Tract 2, fences and gates provided in a required yard may exceed four feet in height.

(3) Maximum fence height is eight feet.

(4) For fences in a required front yard in Tract 2, the surface area of fence panels must be a minimum of 50 percent open. (Ord. Nos. 28118; 31098)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.114. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(c) In Tract 2, the athletic fields are subject to the following restrictions:

(1) Lighted use of the athletic fields is limited to University Interscholastic League (UIL) games or practices involving at least one Dallas Independent School District team.

(2) Except as provided in this subsection, athletic fields may only be lit for scheduled games between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 10:00 p.m.

(3) Except as provided in this subsection, athletic fields may only be lit for practices between the hours of 8:00 a.m. and 6:30 p.m.

(4) Lights must be switched off within 15 minutes of the completion of any game, except that one light standard for each field may remain on for 30 minutes after completion of a game to allow for maintenance of the fields.

(5) Athletic fields may not be lit on Sundays. (Ord. Nos. 28118; 31098)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-844.115. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 28118)
